column1: # Case table for substrate/.github/workflows/pre-merge-gate.yml
# TAB-separated: <name> <context k=v;k=v> <expect-run csv> <expect-skip csv>
# 171 repos call this workflow, so a job that silently stops selecting here
# stops gating 171 repos at once and every one of them stays green. That is the
# whole reason this table exists.
# Two properties worth asserting explicitly, because both are the kind that rot
# without anyone noticing:
#   - each `run-*` toggle actually gates its job (all-toggles-off proves it);
#   - the language gates are mutually exclusive on repo-type, so a python repo
#     never silently runs the rust gate and vice versa.
# Every context path a case's conditions touch must be declared — an undeclared
# path is an error, not an empty default, so these rows are verbose on purpose.
rust-workspace-everything-on
rust-single-crate
npm-repo
python-repo
# action-shell-ban is the one job with NO toggle — it keys purely on repo-type,
# so it cannot be turned off by a caller. That is deliberate (★★ NO-SHELL) and
# is asserted here so a future toggle would have to change this row.
github-action-repo
# publish-dry-run is the only job that keys off repo-type NOT being unknown.
unknown-repo-type-skips-publish-verify
# Proves every toggle is load-bearing: with all of them off and no matching
# repo-type, `detect` is the only job left. If a toggle ever stops gating, this
# row is what notices.
all-toggles-off
